text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach on /v1/streaming/generate (service=inference-api) detected at 2026-03-14T02:15:12Z. Current p99=2.9s (SLO=1.0s). Trigger: streaming stalls + increased tail latency. Auto-page: #incidents.
alice: ack — I'm on it. Observing similar spike across all regions? any region-specifics?
bob-sre: looking. Metrics show control-plane config_fetch latency spiking at the same time as inference p99. traces point to auth/config fetch calls before streaming init. suspect DB auth/config read path.
sasha: attaching quick flamegraph and spanner metrics. flame shows a lot of time in `config-service:ResolveFlags` calls. Also seeing a lot of 5xx from `/controlplane/v1/config`.
db-team: seeing increased RCU on the metadata table and a backlog of auth token lookups. Likely throttling on the read replica pool. investigating DB-side slow queries.
ryan: logs from edge:
```
2026-03-14T02:14:53Z inference-api[worker]: [warn] failed to fetch config for deployment=redwood-streamer err=504
2026-03-14T02:14:53Z inference-api[worker]: [error] auth: token lookup latency 1200ms
```
alice: impact estimate? how many active streams affected?
bob-sre: quick estimate from datadog: ~12% of active streaming sessions show >1s delay in first-token; error rate for config fetchs jumped from 0.06% -> 3.8% in last 10m.
pm-amy: Customer impact: support queue flagged 7 enterprise customers with degraded streaming. Need comms if this is >30min.
alice: immediate mitigation ideas: 1) enable cached config fallback in inference-api, 2) throttle non-critical clients, 3) add route to fail-open on config fetch (serve with last-known-good). Which one is quick?
sasha: cached config fallback is a flip in the service: `FEATURE_FLAGS: USE_CACHED_CONFIG=true` — can be rolled via k8s rollout. It's quick but needs careful validation for critical feature flags.
bob-sre: I can flip cached fallback and scale config-service to 3 -> 6 pods. Also open DB-side read pool for short term.
db-team: scaling read replica pool on DB cluster now. running:
```
ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = 500; -- applying to replica pool
-- raising read pool workers
```
(oncall-shiftbot): page alice oncall
alice: assigning myself and bob-sre. Bob, can you run the config-service scale and flip cached fallback? I'll coordinate DB changes with db-team.
bob-sre: doing `kubectl set env deployment/config-service USE_CACHED_CONFIG=true` and `kubectl scale deploy config-service --replicas=6` now.
... (2m)
bob-sre: rolled cached fallback + scaled config-service. monitoring.
db-team: read pool increase applied, replica lag under control. seeing reduced queue.
sasha: metrics are already improving. p95 dropped from 1.4s -> 0.8s over last 3m. p99 trending down to 1.1s.
ryan: pushing a temporary rate-limit on anonymous/beta API keys to reduce pressure: `rate-limit:beta=10rps` now in place.
alice: good. can someone confirm streaming stalls stopped? any ongoing 5xx?
bob-sre: 5xx from config endpoint down to 0.3%. streaming stalls largely resolved, a few stragglers for long-lived sessions — those may need reconnect.
pm-amy: summarizing customer impact for comms: 7 enterprise customers, partial degradation (higher latency, rare stalls), started 02:14Z, peak 02:15-02:21Z, mitigated by 02:22Z. we'll prepare a brief.
alice: taking incident to SEV-2. owner: alice (oncall). bob-sre and db-team are action owners for remediation.
oncall-shiftbot: new on-call handoff scheduled at 2026-03-14T03:00Z. who's taking next?
alice: I'm handing off at 03:00Z. @sasha please be on-call for the next hour for watch and metrics.
sasha: ack, will monitor and prepare post-incident notes.
bob-sre: we should add short-term safety valves: circuit-break on config fetch path (fail-open after 3s), and sticky cache TTL=120s.
db-team: we recommend a DB schema check on auth token index that had heavy scans — open a ticket and will investigate tomorrow. potential hot key on `tenant_id=NULL` lookups.
ryan: for immediate customer guidance — suggest asking affected customers to reconnect if they see stalls; we can provide a short explanation and ETA for postmortem.
pm-amy: I'll draft a succinct comms note to CSMs: cause suspected throttling on control-plane DB -> config fetch/auth latency -> streaming stalls. mitigated by caching + scaling + DB pool increase. ETA for detailed postmortem: EOD tomorrow.
alice: current status: p99 0.9s, p95 0.45s, error-rate back to baseline. continue 30m watch. Owners: alice (incident), bob-sre (service config remediation), db-team (db follow-up), pm-amy (customer comms).
sasha: recording a timeline for postmortem. also capturing flags rolled: `USE_CACHED_CONFIG=true`, rate-limit on beta keys, replica pool bump.
alice: thanks everyone. if metrics re-regress, re-open thread and escalate to infra lead. logging handoff to next oncall.
oncall-shiftbot: handoff reminder: `alice` -> `sasha` at 2026-03-14T03:00Z.
sasha: taking watch. I'll collect trace samples and put a link to the incident doc in #incidents-docs.
alice: closing paging alert for now. we'll follow up with RCA ticket: INF-8241."
